title: saf-orb run record, version 1
description: What one saf-orb threshold check ran, on which HDF files, against which thresholds, with which SAF CLI, and its verdicts: written as <report_name>.run-record.json when the threshold command's run_record parameter is true. Fields are only ever added within version 1; a change that would break a reader gets a new schema URL.

command.description: The orb command that wrote the record.

outcome.description: passed: every file met the thresholds. failed: a file didn't, which failed the step. failed-reported: a file didn't, passed because report_only is true. error: the SAF CLI could not check a file, so there is no verdict, and the step failed.

exit_code.description: 1 when the outcome is error, else 0. The step's own exit code also depends on report_only.

ci.description: The CI job the command ran in: a CircleCI job (from CIRCLE_BUILD_URL, CIRCLE_SHA1, CIRCLE_JOB and the project), or a GitHub Actions run (from GITHUB_SERVER_URL, GITHUB_REPOSITORY, GITHUB_RUN_ID, GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT, GITHUB_SHA and GITHUB_JOB); null elsewhere.

working_directory.description: The absolute directory the command ran in.

tool.description: The SAF CLI that ran; null when it was not found.

install.description: The install record this orb's install command wrote beside it: the release, the package it came from with its SHA-512, and how it was checked; null for a SAF CLI installed otherwise.

inputs.description: The HDF files checked, with their SHA-256.

thresholds.description: The thresholds, as the nested template handed to the SAF CLI: compliance.min and .max, <status>.total, <status>.total.min and .max, and <status>.<severity>.min, .max and .controls.

gate.description: The settings the step's exit code follows.

results.description: Each file's verdict, in the order checked.

profile.description: The file's first profile, the one the SAF CLI checks.

message.description: The first threshold not met, as the SAF CLI says it, or why there is no verdict.

compliance.description: The compliance the SAF CLI computed, in percent; null when it couldn't.

reports.description: The report files written before the record, with their SHA-256.
